maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from outpatient diagnostic imaging services (MRI, CT, mammography) for patients, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Imaging exams are paid mostly by commercial insurers and some Medicare; most revenue is not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through steady acquisitions of imaging center groups and joint ventures with health systems, expanding to 442 centers across many states.

mission_critical.reason: Patients and referring physicians can choose other imaging centers fairly easily; services are widely available and insurer-network driven.

notes: Payer mix and acquisition pace come from general knowledge, not the website text.
